verified_facts.text: Stanly Ranch is at 200 Stanly Crossroad in Napa, California, on the southern edge of Napa Valley near the Napa River.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stanly Ranch is located at 200 Stanly Crossroad in Napa, California, on the southern edge of Napa Valley near the Napa River.

verified_facts.text: The resort is set on a historic wine country ranch founded in 1856 by Judge Edward Stanly.
verified_facts.excerpt: set on a historic wine country ranch founded in 1856 by Judge Edward Stanly.

verified_facts.text: Guestrooms are cottage-like, with in-room seating areas and grand doors that open onto generous private terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: cottage-like guestrooms marry rustic charm and progressive design, boasting in-room seating areas and grand doors that open onto generous private terraces.

verified_facts.text: The Springhouse circuit includes a salt room, cedar sauna, hyperbaric oxygen chamber, tepidarium and cold plunge.
verified_facts.excerpt: hitting the Springhouse Circuit, which includes a salt room, cedar sauna, hyperbaric oxygen chamber, tepidarium, and cold plunge.

verified_facts.text: Halehouse offers individualized wellbeing programs designed by wellness specialists, medical professionals and sports experts, covering nourishment, hydration, sleep, movement and targeted treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: leading wellness specialists, medical professionals, and sports experts from around the world tailor individualized programs that incorporate nourishment, hydration, sleep, movement, and targeted treatments

verified_facts.text: Dinner at Bear highlights Napa Valley ingredients using techniques such as grilling and fermenting alongside more traditional preparations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dinner is a convivial experience highlighting the ingredients of Napa Valley through techniques such as grilling and fermenting alongside more traditional preparations

verified_facts.text: Stanly Ranch is a working ranch, and its menus are sustainably sourced and seasonally driven.
verified_facts.excerpt: utilizes its unique position as a one of a kind, working ranch to create sustainably sourced and seasonally driven menus and dining experiences.

verified_facts.text: Basin Bar sits between the Lavender pool and the kids pool and serves light dishes, wood fire pizzas and cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled between the Lavender and kids pools, Basin Bar offers light dishes, wood fire pizzas, vibrant cocktails and refreshing wines that complement days spent poolside.

verified_facts.text: Gavel is a coffee shop serving freshly baked pastries and Sightglass Coffee roasts.
verified_facts.excerpt: A buzzing coffee shop complete with freshly baked pastries, local provisions and specialty roasts from Sightglass Coffee.

verified_facts.text: Stanly Ranch has three pools, including a family pool and the spa pool at Halehouse.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stanly Ranch has three mountain-view pools, including a family pool and the spa pool at Halehouse.

verified_facts.text: Stanly Ranch is a dog-friendly resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, Stanly Ranch is a dog-friendly resort.

verified_facts.text: San Francisco Airport is about a 1 hour 20 minute drive from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: San Francisco Airport (SFO) is 87 miles to the resort and approximately a 1 hour and 20 minute drive.

verified_facts.text: Downtown Napa is about 10 minutes from the resort and Sonoma about 20 minutes.
verified_facts.excerpt: the tasting rooms, restaurants, and shops of downtown Napa and Sonoma are 10 and 20 minutes away, respectively.

verified_facts.text: Family-friendly experiences include farm tours, hot air balloon rides and falconry, and the resort has a dedicated family pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Family-friendly educational experiences include farm tours, hot air balloon rides, and falconry, plus there’s a dedicated family pool.

verified_facts.text: The resort's vineyards are all organically grown.
verified_facts.excerpt: The resort’s vineyards are all organically grown.

verified_facts.text: The concierge can arrange a helicopter tasting with Donum Estate.
verified_facts.excerpt: A great example is the helicopter tasting they can arrange with Donum Estate.

verified_facts.text: Group fitness classes, including yoga, pilates, barre and HIIT, are complimentary to in-house guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choose from a variety of daily movement classes, available complimentary to in-house guests.

verified_facts.text: Designer Jen Clausen gave the rooms a modern farmhouse look with leather and oak furnishings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designer Jen Clausen created a modern farmhouse vibe, using leather and oak furnishings and oatmeal and beige hues throughout the rooms.

verified_facts.text: Villas have two bedrooms and a gourmet kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: each Villa is complete with two bedrooms, a gourmet kitchen and expansive terraces that invite the outdoors in.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists Stanly Ranch among its Readers' Choice Awards winners for 2023 through 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026
